create_ExaoneMoeConfig: create an ExaoneMoeConfig instance to initialize the EXAONE MoE model configuration
initialize_ExaoneMoe_config: initialize ExaoneMoeConfig with custom parameters like num_experts, sliding_window, and hidden_size
build_ExaoneMoe_model: build an ExaoneMoeModel from ExaoneMoeConfig for a mixture-of-experts transformer
configure_sliding_window_attention: configure sliding window attention pattern using sliding_window and sliding_window_pattern parameters
configure_moe_experts: configure MoE expert routing with num_experts, num_experts_per_tok, and routed_scaling_factor settings
